title: Find X-Sum of All K-Long Subarrays I
summary: Given an array of integers nums, two integers k and x, calculate the x-sum for each k-long subarray.
statement: Given an array of integers nums, two integers k and x, calculate the x-sum for each k-long subarray. The x-sum involves counting the frequency of elements, retaining the top x most frequent, and summing them. If fewer than x distinct elements, sum all. Return an array of length n-k+1, where each element is the x-sum of the corresponding subarray.
constraints: For every contiguous subarray of length k, count each distinct value.
Keep the x values with greatest frequency, breaking frequency ties in favor of the larger value.
The x-sum is the ordinary sum of all occurrences of the kept values.
reference_solution:
def x_sum_of_k_subarrays(nums,k,x):
    from collections import Counter
    answer=[]
    for left in range(len(nums)-k+1):
        counts=Counter(nums[left:left+k])
        chosen=sorted(counts,key=lambda value:(counts[value],value),reverse=True)[:x]
        answer.append(sum(value*counts[value] for value in chosen))
    return answer

hints: Build a frequency table for each length-k window.
Rank distinct values by frequency first and numeric value second, both descending.
Take at most x ranked values and add value times frequency.
Repeating this for every start produces exactly one x-sum per window.
